question: By what agency is that which is perceptible to the unmanifest said to have been born, addressed to one of great compassion?
premises: Something perceptible to the unmanifest is in view.
It is said to have been born by that means.
Families are named as the instrumental agency.
inference: By that agency, families brought into being what is perceptible to the unmanifest.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' is not recoverable from this verse alone.
plain_english: O greatly compassionate one, by that means it was born through families, as that which is perceptible to the unmanifest.
